title: Nonhuman implementation implications: consumer hazards, whole-envelope semantics and estimate limits
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full historical implementation audit/proposal; current ownership and selected-consumer gates qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full read covers IM-F1–F5, IM-T1–T10, IM-D1–D9, IM-S1–S8, IM-V1–V10, IM-C1–C5, fifteen body-cost rows, IM-R1–R12, IM-Q1–Q2 and IM-A1–A5. The dirty Oct14 snapshot, line locators, 109 test files and negative test searches are dated source evidence, not a current absence or defect census. Existing combat arrays, keyed streams and bounded Tern support already corrected earlier broad missing-engine claims. Current Nov3/Nov4 owner receipts qualify old shared-foundation holds; this report grants no runtime reservation or authorization. Read each old dependency against the actual selected consumer rather than restarting R1, World1, a picker redesign or the whole proposed body foundation.

F2. Preserve the useful consumer hazards: physical form versus cosmetic race, body bootstrap versus service enrollment/clock joining, early validation versus later migration, source capability versus actual anatomy, direct mutation versus disabled button, and heir expansion replacement versus selected successor retention. A compatibility body installed too early can block a fresh-only origin; nested anatomy cannot pass through a scalar opcode just because the JSON parses. Explicit unknown form/revision needs recoverable retained data and a supported compatibility outcome rather than silent human fallback. Proposed fork3/body1/simulation7 and early normalization order are designs to qualify against live writers, not reserved current versions or proof every selected consumer needs this migration.

F3. Full-envelope semantics matter beyond a body-only JSON roundtrip. Preserve pinned start/life/content identity, dormant/absent worlds, actual native offsets, finite sap/clay reserves, equipped goods, jobs, control and receipts across supported loaders. An export can have its declared timestamp/inspiration effect; compare invariants with those known changes rather than demand byte equality or ignore unexplained differences. Forward schema compatibility is not promised backward compatibility: old code plus a generated pre-upgrade export loses later progress absent a tested reverse adapter. Feature hiding or flattening a new body to human is not rollback. Preflight/storage failure preserves precommit state; a UI/publication failure after durable success must repair publication without refund or replay of the committed operation.

F4. IM-V's seeded/source/loader/native distinctions remain useful. Historical negative grep, parsed fixtures, source tests, natural acquisition, served bytes, browser journey and literal-file transport prove different scopes. Choose affected existing checks and failure cases under AD36/AD43, reuse unchanged relevant evidence, and avoid treating this ten-row planning matrix as ten universal suites. AD42 keeps director taste optional. The old1366-primary gate and one-realm/prestige milestone, including their IM-Q2 repetition, are superseded; current desktop/campaign owners apply. Routine reversible choices and already-authorized premises do not need a new confirmation because a historical conditional question appears here.

F5. All hour ranges, 8/32/128-body examples, cohort/job/override/tie ceilings,256KiB target,4ms p95/50ms operation targets and backup-size arithmetic are unmeasured planning assumptions. UTF-16 origin bytes, UTF-8 payload and base64 file bytes remain distinct. Actual browser quota can differ. These numbers are not world laws or evidence of measured engine throughput. Keep named injured/committed people and material obligations when reducing detail; cosmetic log pruning cannot delete durable replay guards or unique custody. ACR compression can preserve actual outcomes/decision boundaries while richer detail changes. Real parallel workers, shared cognition or renewable power can earn legitimate output under AD22/AD38, without duplicate interval settlement or forced human-equivalent caps. No runtime, numerical balance, source acquisition, migration, browser or performance result is newly established here.
reviews.evidence: Entire376-line input delivered in ranges1–130,131–260,261–376. No current code grep, loader, generated save, primary book or performance test run.
reviews.reopen: Actual selected body/bootstrap/XP/transition/save consumer changes; inspect current allocation/authority and choose affected existing checks before implementation. No new runtime work authorized by reconciliation.
